notes: 1.5.0：她每次回話前會先記下你說的新事情；語音說話時嘴巴跟著聲音動；重點分頁改成一個可以搜尋的清單，FOLLOW-UP 併進去；她偶爾會主動問你的事或分享看法；搜尋加上「猜你想搜」；精確位置只問一次。
notes_en: 1.5.0: before every reply she notes anything new you said; her mouth follows her voice; the Memory tab is one searchable list with follow-ups merged in; now and then she asks about you or shares her view; Search suggests what you might be looking for; precise location is asked only once.
